caption: The drawing features three distinct textile designs arranged vertically on a beige background. At the top, there is a rectangular strip with an ornate pattern featuring red, blue, and green colors, consisting of repeating stylized leaf motifs and swirling forms, bordered by decorative bands. In the middle is a horizontal strip with a striped pattern in alternating shades of green, blue, beige, and pink, with all stripes running parallel to the length of the strip. At the bottom, there is a fringe composed of light green strands that hang down loosely, creating a scalloped appearance. The name "FRITZ BOEHM" is written in small, capital letters near the lower right side of the drawing.
title: Upholstery Trim
